title: Israeli Business-Day and Payment-Terms Calculator input
description: Business-day maths on Israeli calendars (Sun-Thu, or Mon-Fri for TASE) plus שוטף+N payment-term due dates. Set the top-level fields for one calculation, or use "calculations" for many at once (each entry overrides the top-level fields it sets).

calculations.title: Calculations (bulk; optional)
calculations.description: One JSON object per calculation, e.g. {"operation":"add","startDate":"2026-09-10","days":5}. Leave this field itself unset (not just empty) to run a single calculation using the fields below instead. An empty object {} uses the fields below as-is.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: add/subtract N business days from startDate; count-between startDate and endDate; next business day after startDate; is-business-day check on startDate; payment-due applies paymentTerms to startDate.
enumTitles: Count business days between two dates

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). For payment-due this is the invoice date.

days.title: Days (for add/subtract)
days.description: Number of business days to add or subtract. A negative value is applied in the opposite direction.

endDate.title: End date (for count-between)
endDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), required when operation is count-between.

paymentTerms.title: Payment terms (for payment-due)
paymentTerms.description: "שוטף+N" or "net-eom+N" (end of the invoice month, plus N calendar days), e.g. "שוטף+60".

calendarProfile.title: Calendar profile
calendarProfile.description: il-workweek-sun-thu: Sunday-Thursday, Friday+Saturday weekend. il-tase-mon-fri: TASE trading calendar (VERIFY: switches to Monday-Friday from 2026-01-05 per this Actor's unverified research brief - see README). iso-mon-fri: plain Monday-Friday, no Israeli holidays. custom: set customWeekendDays yourself.

rollConvention.title: Roll convention (for payment-due)
rollConvention.description: How to move a computed date that lands on a non-business day onto one: following (forward), modified-following (forward, unless that crosses into the next month, then backward), preceding (backward).

customWeekendDays.title: Custom weekend days (for calendarProfile=custom)
customWeekendDays.description: Weekday numbers that are weekend days: 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday. Defaults to [5,6] (Friday+Saturday) if left empty.

extraHolidays.title: Extra holidays
extraHolidays.description: ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that are never business days, in addition to the profile's own holiday set (e.g. an ad-hoc election day).

halfDaysAreBusiness.title: Count half-days as business days
halfDaysAreBusiness.description: Erev-chag afternoons and, on the TASE profile, Friday's early close are "half days". True (default) counts them as business days (flagged halfDay); false treats them as non-business.
